2609.10901.title: SearchAtlas: Analyzing Agentic Search Strategies via Evidential Query Graphs
2609.10901.paper_summary: LLM search agents are often evaluated on final-answer accuracy, overlooking the process. Analyzing a search strategy requires understanding how credible evidence is retrieved to address question constraints. This valuable information is buried in raw search trajectories that are long and difficult to parse. We introduce SearchAtlas, a framework that converts search trajectories into structured graphs whose edges represent how evidence is propagated across the reasoning trace, from the query that retrieves it to the final answer. Our automated parsing pipeline achieves a mean edge F1 of 86.0% against human-annotated graphs and remains consistent across repeated runs. We analyze five search agents on three benchmarks, revealing systematic differences in search scale and evidence aggregation. SearchAtlas exposes fragmented answer support, question constraints that do not reach the answer, and unverified parametric knowledge entering the response. These process failures are strongly associated with incorrect answers, even more so than an LLM judge given either the raw trajectory or the ordered query list, suggesting that the constructed graphs provide useful interpretability. Moreover, an audit of cases in which process-diagnostic scores disagree with final-answer correctness shows that they capture information not reducible to answer accuracy.
2609.10901.paper_summary_zh: LLM 搜尋代理通常在最終答案的準確性上進行評估，而忽略了過程。分析搜尋策略需要理解如何檢索可信的證據以滿足問題的約束。這些有價值的信息埋藏在原始搜尋軌跡中，這些軌跡既長又難以解析。我們引入了 SearchAtlas，一個將搜尋軌跡轉換為結構化圖的框架，其邊緣代表證據如何在推理痕跡中傳播，從檢索到的查詢到最終答案。我們的自動解析管道在與人類標註的圖進行比較時，達到了 86.0% 的平均邊緣 F1，並且在重複運行中保持一致。我們在三個基準上分析了五個搜尋代理，揭示了搜尋規模和證據聚合的系統性差異。SearchAtlas 揭示了支撐答案的片段化、未能達到答案的問題約束，以及進入回應的未經驗證的參數知識。這些過程失敗與錯誤答案有很強的關聯性，甚至比 LLM 評判者在獲得原始軌跡或有序查詢列表時的表現更為明顯，這表明構建的圖提供了有用的可解釋性。此外，對於過程診斷分數與最終答案正確性不一致的案例進行的審核顯示，它們捕捉到的信息無法簡化為答案的準確性。
